result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products whose quantity is 0. In your example, WH-1 shows only "Bolt 10".

The change is one line in `DataStore.listStockByWarehouse` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, around line 1491). I added `AND s.quantity > 0` to the query, the same filter the other stock overviews use.

The single-product quantity lookup is a separate query, so asking for nuts in WH-1 still answers 0.

I ran the `Stock*` tests and they pass. I didn't add a test for the zero-quantity case.
